subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King telepathically screamed about shedding his humanoid form for supreme power and his intention to reduce all of the Underdark to ooze.
source_quote: The Pudding King telepathically screams about shedding his humanoid form for supreme power and his intention to reduce all of the Underdark to ooze.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King dissolved, screaming telepathically: 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!'
source_quote: The Pudding King dissolves, screaming telepathically: 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!'

subject: Glabbagool
fact: A voice resembling Glabbagool emanated from the ooze near Thorin, asking 'why are you hurting me?'
source_quote: A voice resembling Glabbagool emanates from the ooze near Thorin, asking 'why are you hurting me?'

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool said 'this tickles' when both Zalthir and the Pudding King were inside him.
source_quote: Glabbagool reacts to having both Zalthir and the Pudding King inside him, saying 'this tickles'.

subject: Juiblex
fact: A demonic voice, possibly Juiblex himself, declared: 'You haven't won. I will be reborn. I will consume the banquet of the queen of the fungi, and I will grow.'
source_quote: A demonic voice, possibly Juiblex himself, declares: 'You haven't won. I will be reborn. I will consume the banquet of the queen of the fungi, and I will grow.'

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool expresses excitement about his new ooze form, seeing it as an opportunity to be carried and experience the world differently.
source_quote: Glabbagool expresses excitement about his new ooze form, seeing it as an opportunity to be carried and experience the world differently.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool suggests he could be carried in a jar or the Bag of Holding and serve as a garbage disposal.
source_quote: Glabbagool suggests he could be carried in a jar or the Bag of Holding and serve as a garbage disposal.

subject: Glabbagool's new form
fact: Glabbagool's new ooze form is not fully understood, and his potential for monk training remains unexplored in this session.
source_quote: The party discusses Glabbagool's potential monk training.

subject: Juiblex's rebirth
fact: Juiblex claims he will be reborn by consuming the Queen of Fungi, but the means and timing of his return are unspecified in this session.
source_quote: A demonic voice, possibly Juiblex himself, declares: 'You haven't won. I will be reborn. I will consume the banquet of the queen of the fungi, and I will grow.'

subject: Zuggtmoy's seizure of power
fact: The fungi becoming more twisted suggests Zuggtmoy is waiting to seize power, but her actions or intentions beyond this are unstated in this session.
source_quote: The fungi in the area become more twisted, suggesting Zuggtmoy is waiting to seize power in the vacuum left by the Pudding King's death.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin asked the ooze where they first met, and it responded 'we met in a cake', confirming it is Glabbagool.
source_quote: Thorin asks the ooze where they first met, and it responds 'we met in a cake', confirming it is Glabbagool.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir drags the Pudding King out of his lair and into Glabbagool's position.
source_quote: Zalthir drags the Pudding King out of his lair and into Glabbagool's position.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir uses Steps of the Wind to dash, moving a significant distance while grappling the Pudding King.
source_quote: Zalthir uses Steps of the Wind to dash, moving a significant distance while grappling the Pudding King.
